summary: WHISPERS: Realm of the Nine is a fantasy MMO spanning the Lantern March, six peoples' homelands and themed dungeon/raid instances. MMORPG Tools owns realm, character and UI lifecycle; ordered player behaviors compose movement, class combat, quests, trade, flight and survival, while streamed scenes and shared YAML data define the world and its encounters.
places: places/main/config.yaml and places/main/cells/ - Lantern March continent, its homelands and roads; streamed scenes hold hubs, quests, encounters and landmarks.
places/main/cells/x-1z-1.scene - Thornwood lumber camp at (-117,-108): sawpit, log piles, cart, shed, stumps and talk-only Bryn Oakhewn; static generator props and one townsfolk NPC.
places/main/cells/x-7z0.scene - Deepgrove bandit camp at (-943,45): palisade, tents, lookout, loot, cookfire and Scab NPC; scenery and talk only, no hostile bandits wired.
places/main/cells/x-1z-5.scene - fallen giant over Road-Starfall at (-80,-680), with scripted rib arches, skull, sword and arm bone; road passes between rib colliders.
places/hollowcrypt/ - underground crypt campaign entered from Hollowcrypt Vale; halls, Archive, Candle Warden and paired gate.
places/drowned-bell/ and places/root-archive/ - themed instanced dungeons with encounter scenes and paired entry/return gates.
places/pale-choir/, places/emberheart/ and places/ninth-assembly/ - themed raid places with encounter bosses and paired gates; endgame path branches through Pale Choir and Emberheart.
places/character-creation-land/ and places/main-menu-land/ - character-creation and realm/menu entry scenes, respectively.
roots: world.config.yaml - defaults to main-menu-land; binds player/camera templates, MMORPG UI, arrival redirect, routing and realm pulse; audio gains set Music .85 and Ambience .55.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/mod.json - registers MMORPG lifecycle, cameras, character/interaction behaviors and UI actions.
templates/player.js#player - ordered locomotion, movement, class, quest, vendor, trades, flight, vitality, cursor-free and region-music behaviors.
templates/camera.js#camera - gameplay camera; MMORPG owns separate menu and character-creation camera paths.
places/main/config.yaml - owns March terrain, roads, regional surfaces/scatter and atmosphere; cell scenes bind structures, quest marks, bosses and NPCs.
places/{hollowcrypt,drowned-bell,root-archive,pale-choir,emberheart,ninth-assembly}/config.yaml - terrain, gravity and spawn environment for crypt and instance play.
places/main/cells/x-10z7.scene - Sorrowfen hub and instance entrances; each gate pairs with an inside gate in its dungeon/raid scene.
mods/gavi/mod.json - registers Gavi crew behavior and panel, the builder-facing companion tools.
shared: mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ - RPG registries, persistence, currency and UI modules reused by MMORPG behaviors, gameplay scripts and ui.js.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/realm-save.js - character persistence, roster population and realm list/detail shared by menu and player lifecycle.
scripts/lib/places.js - PLAY/isPlay and SAFE_HOME registry shared by quests, class actions, vitality and regional music; playable places are listed here.
scripts/gen/instance.js - shared geometry/layout generator for dungeon and raid places; scenes select layout and kind via params.
scripts/lib/data/quests.yml + MMORPG lib/quest-data.js - quest mechanics and lookup shared by quest-core, quest-giver and quest UI; quest-text.js supplies prose.
scripts/lib/data/bosses.yml + scripts/boss.js - encounter definitions and common boss behavior for dungeon, raid and open-world bosses; boss IDs also key gear loot tables.
scripts/lib/data/gear.yml - boss loot tables, item stats and tier data consumed by quest-player, quest-core and kit.js; tier data also selects loot-drop sound.
scripts/lib/data/music.yml + scripts/region-music.js - shared themes, per-area ambience beds and stinger sets for player-region audio.
notableExports: scripts/lib/places.js - PLAY, isPlay, SAFE_HOME; scripts/gen/instance.js - LAYOUTS, roomsOf, geometry.
scripts/gen/homeland.js - geometry, collider; params.kind selects hollow, vault, reedcage or bloom geometry.
scripts/gen/roothome.js and scripts/gen/stilt.js - geometry, collider for Thornhollow root-homes and Saltborn stilt fish-houses.
scripts/gen/ruin.js and scripts/gen/hamlet.js - geometry, collider; ruin kinds dress the Ward Lamphouse, hamlet includes race-hamlet structures.
scripts/gen/armory.js, scripts/gen/waystone.js, scripts/gen/apothecary.js, scripts/gen/caravan.js and scripts/gen/harbor.js - geometry/collider generators for varied settlement props and landmarks.
scripts/gen/camp.js, scripts/gen/giant.js and scripts/gen/shrine.js - geometry, collider; kind/seed params vary camp and giant, shrine builds the blood-shrine piece.
scripts/lib/kit.js - power, gearPower, gearHealth, materialOf, meleeFoley and shared combat helpers; materialOf and meleeFoley route contact sounds through foley.yml.
scripts/instance-gate.js - onTriggerEnter, onCross, onRefuse; scripts/boss.js - onSpawn, update; MMORPG lib/version.js - GAME_VERSION, GAME_TITLE, versionTag (0.41.3 Alpha).
ownership: scripts/player.js - room-local movement intent and velocity/footstep state; place config owns gravity.
MMORPG player.js and lib/realm-save.js - active character, roster snapshots and persisted character records, including professions, inventory, equipment and quest state.
scripts/vanguard.js, arcanist.js, pathfinder.js and shade.js - class action/cooldown/combat state; kit.js supplies common targeting, damage, drill, gear power and melee foley.

scripts/quest-core.js - quest interactions, progression, dialogue, inventory/cache/mark state, owedItems delivery and _questSave; quest-player.js owns kill tally/XP, lockouts, loot and equipment-derived maxHealth.
scripts/boss.js - placed boss hp/mode/cast/enrage/target-related fields; encounter clocks, damage attribution and target scratch live in boss ctx.session.
scripts/instance-gate.js - gate state.link/minLevel/entry quest tally configuration; on entry stamps player's _worldEnterAt and conditionally increments tally.
scripts/region-music.js - per-player theme/music transition and ambience bed (player.ambience); region-music session tracks current bed and next stinger time.
world.config.yaml - global audio bus gains and maxVoices; scripts/lib/data/foley.yml and music.yml own sound clip mappings, not runtime player state.
flows: world.config.yaml defaultPlace main-menu-land → main-menu-mgr/main-menu UI → realm roster or character selection → creation/enter-world → gameplay lifecycle.

Arrival outside main-menu-land without fresh _worldEnterAt or creation-place _creationEnterAt → scripts/arrival.js redirects to menu; menu and scripts/crypt-gate.js/instance-gate.js stamp allowed transitions.
main-menu-mgr loads current-room SQL roster; api.enterPlace routes selected character to saved place/position; routing validates requested room, then last room, then main.
scripts/lib/data/realms.yml → scripts/routing.js and crons/realm-pulse.js; cron writes room player count to realm_pulse, realm-save reads pulses and refreshes realmList/realmDetail.
Character creation race/class → lib/races.js start and character state → MMORPG player.js/realm-save upsert to characters keyed by user, realm and slot.

templates/player.js order → locomotion → movement → class handlers → quest-player → vendor → trades → flight → vitality → cursor-free → region-music; player.js/wow-move.js consume movement/camera intents.

First eligible quest-player input/update in a scripts/lib/places.js isPlay place → dynamic import quest-core; quests.yml + quest-data define mechanics, quest-text.js supplies prose, ui-quest renders it.
scripts/townsfolk.js greets placed talker NPCs; quest-player.js reads scripts/lib/data/townsfolk.yml by state.who for dialogue, including Scab and Bryn.

Main-place entrance gate (state.link, minLevel, enterQuest/enterTally) → instance-gate checks player/level and active quest, stamps _worldEnterAt and ctx.crosses to paired +place#gate; inside twin returns through its link.

Instance scenes bind scripts/gen/instance.js with layout/kind params; LAYOUTS and roomsOf produce shared themed room shells, corridors, floors and furnishings while scene placements supply encounters and props.

Boss scene state.boss → scripts/boss.js reads bosses.yml; class scripts write hp/lastHitBy/lastHitAt, abilities telegraph then land, and credited kills emit to hero quest-player for tally/XP and gear rolls/sounds.

Player-region update → region-music.js selects music.yml theme, sets the player's ambience bed, and schedules per-player stingers; kit.js meleeFoley selects foley.yml material clips, while gear.yml tier.sound feeds quest-player loot audio.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/instance.js - reused across instance places, varied by layout (room dimensions, corridor length, materials/colors) and kind (halls, pillar, brazier, dais, bell, organ, seat, rootcol); scene placements share layout coordinates.

scripts/boss.js + scripts/lib/data/bosses.yml - one AI across dungeon/raid and open-world placements, varied by boss definition: hp, arena, abilities/telegraphs, phases, enrage, rewards and sound/clips.
scripts/gen/homeland.js - landmarks/foliage reused at homeland encounter sites, varied by kind (hollow, vault, reedcage, bloom), scale and seed; scene binds static colliders for landmark structures.

scripts/gen/ashen.js, scripts/gen/ashen-village.js and scripts/gen/grave-ground.js - Ashen Close graveyard, cathedral yard, gothic village pieces and consolidated graveyard cover; helper, kind, seed, LOD and dimensions vary pieces.
scripts/gen/fen.js - procedural marsh props recur in Sorrowfen, Reedhaven Refuge and Starfall Eyrie quest sites, varied by kind/seed/LOD; boardwalk geometry and collider share dimensions.
scripts/gen/tide.js - Tideglass structures and props share shape helpers; kind/LOD/length/width vary each piece.
scripts/gen/hamlet.js, scripts/gen/roothome.js and scripts/gen/stilt.js - reused in race hamlets and March settlements, varied by kind, seed, dimensions and stilt/deck height.
scripts/gen/lumber.js - Thornwood lumber-camp sawpit, log piles, stumps, cart and shed share procedural geometry, varied by kind, seed and stump axe detail.
probableOrphans: scripts/gen/grave-weeds.js - no scene or other package reference; graveyard cover is currently placed through grave-ground.js instead.
migrationNotes: Adding a playable place requires a row in scripts/lib/places.js PLAY; dying heroes rise at SAFE_HOME for listed dungeons/raids. Quest and class logic uses isPlay rather than hard-coded place names.

Instance room walls/corridors and scene furnishing placement share layout coordinates: entry is z=0, chambers chain toward -Z, floor y=0; keep scripts/gen/instance.js roomsOf arithmetic consistent with scenes.
Gate links are explicit +place#object links on paired gates; instance-gate checks minLevel and active enterQuest before crossing, stamps _worldEnterAt for arrival.js, and only then counts enterTally.

Boss combat writes shared hp/lastHitBy/lastHitAt fields; boss.js emits kills to each hero's behavior machine so quest-player owns tally/XP and gear rolls. Keep scene state.boss IDs aligned with bosses.yml and gear.yml.
Money is one integer copper amount; 100 copper = 1 silver and 100 silver = 1 gold. Route transactions through scripts/lib/economy.js to preserve purse floor, ledger and UI feedback.

Melee material selection is state.material first, then boss mapping, wolf fur/dummy wood, otherwise flesh; foley.yml hit rows and heavy layer are consumed by kit.meleeFoley. Gear tier sound is read at reward time; music ambience is player-specific and configured separately from music buses.
